# ECONOMIC IMPACTS GENERATED BY COVID-19 IN THE DEPARTMENT OF ANTIOCIA

In the department of Antioquia, the impacts generated by the pandemic, and the consequent confinement and partial closure of productive activities, are evidenced by the evolution of an important group of social and economic variables. The crisis caused by the eruption of Covid-19 has deepened the pre-existing inequalities (Bergallo et al., 2021). This research investigates these behaviors, focusing its attention on employment (with a special treatment for the case of informal employment), the levels of poverty and distribution of wealth, and, finally, the behavior of the business base
